messages:
ben: heads-up from today's onboarding: CSV bulk import (paginated) experienced repeating stalls and then a respiral of 429s on page 5 onward. customer replayed live and we could reproduce.
priya: which SDK and sample-app flags?
ben: node-sdk v2.5.1, sample-importer v4.0. ran with `--page-size=250 --streams=6`.
todd: logs (trimmed): ```
[2030-06-12T10:14:01Z] page=1 queued=6 sent=250
[2030-06-12T10:14:02Z] page=2 queued=6 sent=250
[2030-06-12T10:14:06Z] page=5 queued=48 stall start
[2030-06-12T10:14:12Z] page=5 flush->sent=48 -> 429 x18
```
ben: interestingly the node SDK batcher was intentionally sticky on session id for caching efficiency and omitted cursor from the batch key. when multiple page workers overlap we end up consolidating requests and then the server rate limit prunes them.
priya: JS historically included cursor in the key for import flows though?
ben: older versions did. a recent optimization moved to session-only keys and we missed marking pagination flows as an exception.
todd: on top of that, retry logic is aggressive: immediate retry on 401 then exponential backoff without jitter. combined with batcher merge, we saw synchronized retries amplifying the issue.
qa-rin: can we get a minimal repro harness for CI? I'd like a deterministic test that spawns N streams and asserts no more than M inflight per second.
priya: fix plan: (1) make batcher key include pagination cursor or page index when opts.pagination.enabled == true (2) introduce randomized jitter to retry backoff and make token refresh singleflight per client (3) add a "pagination_aware" flag on sample-importer to opt-in during onboarding.
ben: patch snippet (JS): ```js
const keyParts = [opts.userId, opts.model];
if (opts.pagination && opts.pagination.cursor) keyParts.push(`cur:${opts.pagination.cursor}`);
const batchKey = keyParts.join('|');
```
todd: also propose a safety net: if queue depth > highWaterMark then force gradual draining instead of single flush: drainChunk = Math.min(queue.length, maxChunkSize); schedule multiple micro-flushes spaced by 50ms. reduces waterfall.
priya: love the micro-drain idea. will add opt-in config `drainChunkSize` and `drainIntervalMs` with sane defaults.
qa-rin: tests: unit for key parity, integration harness with `--streams 6 --page-size 250` that asserts no >20% drop success rate and no >10 429s in 60s window. add to CI e2e matrix.
sdk-bot: opened PR #2337 "node: pagination-aware batch key + micro-drain" assigned to @priya.
ops-lara: mitigation: temporarily set org override to reduce node-sdk concurrency to 3 for demo tenants; also toggled sample-importer flag to `--pagination_aware=false` to use safer sequential streams. that bought time for the customer call.
ben: will update onboarding docs and quickstart note: "For large CSV imports, enable pagination-aware batching or limit client concurrency."
priya: I'll include changelog, tests, and a staging canary. aiming to canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: staging, image=node-sdk:fix-paginator-2337, start=2030-06-13T09:00:00Z
ops-lara: will keep org overrides active until canary is green and will notify support.
ben: thanks team 44: will post follow-up after canary results.
qa-rin: adding the repro harness to flaky-tests so we catch regressions.
